name: Ads Lighthouse API
description: Read account-scoped monitoring data and reports, and update project, team, alert and review workflows through the same services and limits as the app. Paid checks and redirect traces use the account's allowances. Authenticate with an API key (Authorization: Bearer als_...). The REST API is available on Scale plans and above. Each credential may make 120 requests per minute. An observation shows an ad was displayed for a search at a moment; it is not proof of a purchased keyword, spend or infringement. The same JSON operations are available as MCP tools at https://adslighthouse.com/api/v1/mcp, included in every plan. File downloads are REST endpoints. Guide: https://adslighthouse.com/api
